name: Baur au Lac
positioning: Family-run hotel in Zurich since 1844, set in its own private park on the shores of Lake Zurich
best_for: Travelers who want a central Zurich base by the lake, a short walk from the Bahnhofstrasse and the Old Town
Multi-generational families wanting rooms with connecting doors

facts.text: Baur au Lac has been in Zurich since 1844.
The hotel sits in its own private park right on the shores of Lake Zurich, in central Zurich.
The Bahnhofstrasse, Buerkliplatz and the historic Old Town, with the Tonhalle and the Opera House, are a short walk away.
Every room and suite is individually designed, with views of the private park, the city or, depending on category, Lake Zurich and the Alps.
The hotel is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World and Swiss Deluxe Hotels.
Marguita sits right on Lake Zurich and serves Mediterranean cuisine.
Le Hall serves desserts from the hotel's own patisserie.
Baur au Lac Vins is a separate wine shop with fine wines, premium spirits and delicacies.
The fitness area has a view of Lake Zurich and the Alps.
Services include a 24-hour concierge, limousine and transfer service from the airport or main station, valet and garage services, and twice-daily housekeeping.
Rooms and suites with connecting doors suit multi-generational stays.
Dogs are welcome at CHF 45 per dog per day, with custom-designed beds, bowls and a special dog menu.

highlights.text: The concierge can arrange private trips on Lake Zurich aboard the historic saloon boat Tugenia.
Baur au Lac is a family-run hotel now in its seventh generation.
Le Hall, the historic lobby bar, is called the living room of Zurich.
The hotel has its own soft toys, Leo and Eli, for children.
Rooms mix Art Deco, Louis XVI and Regency styles.

considerations.text: Dogs are not permitted in the restaurants, except on the Marguita terrace.
Lake and Alps views depend on the room category; other rooms look over the private park or the city.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
